observed: Two crowded round posts leave a paper-strewn aisle between them.
A trader stands on the left counter with a phone, another pins a card to a wall board, and another runs across the foreground carrying a slip.
A paper plane crosses between the posts; a seated trader sleeps near a small raised flag at the left post.
Closely packed CRT screens and corded phones support varied standing and seated postures.
corrections: Replace the monitors' multicoloured tables with token emblems and single brass price lines, without words or numbers in the drawing.
Remove any paper-plane motion trail; pose, placement and actual motion carry the throw.
Provide a visible unlit lamp at the sleeping station.
Keep the raised flag tied to waiting for the owner, not to the nearby sleeping trader or general activity.
Use the picked character bodies and curled-wrist throw; determine scene positions and the camera in the proportions round.

Colour audit 13 October: strengthen the sampled timber visible range (observed pair 1.989:1, incomplete orientation evidence), lift dark outlined faces, replace coloured numerical screen rows with brass line and scale, and remove paper writing and light gradients.
